unit_contract.search_volume: Monthly searches reported by a keyword tool. null when unknown.
unit_contract.impressions_90d: This domain's own impressions over the measured GSC window (90 days). null when unknown.
unit_contract.demand_basis: Which field rank_score used: search_volume | impressions_90d | none.
unit_contract.removed_field: `volume` is removed. It previously held BOTH monthly search volume (semrush rows) and this domain's own 90d impressions (gsc rows), so rank_score compared incompatible units. A missing key throws; a wrong number does not.
unit_contract.never: Do not sum or compare across units. Volumes from disagreeing packets are recorded in volume_sources with volume_conflict=true and are never averaged.
unit_contract.precedent: Follows portfolio_demand.json (portfolio-demand-v1), which separated volume_mo from demand_signal/demand_signal_unit for this same defect.

discovery_gap_pass.why: 62 measured queries carried demand and nothing else. Demand says how many people ask; it does not say whether the answer is winnable or whether the asker is near a form. Both of those are now recorded.
expansion_sources: data/agency/gsc_snapshot.json (live Search Console snapshot) - joined for phrasing not yet ingested
refused_sources: data/queries/evidence/bing_keyword_research_2026-08-26.json - T2a in a third unit (Bing Webmaster impressions). A T2a row with demand_basis "none" is refused by scripts/atlas/validate_query_atlas.mjs, correctly. Left separate pending a deliberate unit decision, as its own note asks.
data/queries/query_universe.json - page targets derived from existing content, not observed phrasing. Not evidence.

openness_method.input: cited_hosts from a grounded run of scripts/llm_citation_probe.mjs (OpenRouter web plugin, engine=parallel, mode=turbo)
openness_method.platform_share: share of distinct cited hosts that are user-generated or aggregator platforms
openness_method.institutional_share: share of distinct cited hosts on .gov/.edu/.mil or wikipedia

verdicts.HELD_BY_US: the engine already cited one of our own domains - not an opportunity, a position to defend
verdicts.OPEN: openness_score >= 0.6 - the answer is assembled from platforms and no authoritative page owns it
verdicts.HELD: openness_score < 0.4 - institutions or established publishers occupy the answer
verdicts.UNMEASURED: the probe has not answered for this query; NOT a zero and never to be read as one

openness_method.not_measured: search volume, keyword difficulty, organic rank. None are inferable from a citation observation and none are written.

rolling_window_policy.why: The probe caps itself at 25 queries per run and only the newest grounded run is read, so most scored rows have no observation in any given window. A row whose observation has rolled out keeps its last reading with stale:true and a stale_reason; it is never downgraded to UNMEASURED, which would read as "we never looked".

stale_reasons.NO_GROUNDED_OBSERVATION_IN_CURRENT_WINDO: measured before, not in the newest grounded run
stale_reasons.PROVIDER_ERROR: the newest run reached the provider and failed; the earlier reading stands
stale_reasons.PROVIDER_ANSWERED_WITHOUT_RETRIEVING: the newest run answered from model memory with no citations; the earlier reading stands

blue_ocean_gate.by: blueOceanEligibility in this script, written to queries[].blue_ocean_eligible
blue_ocean_gate.why: An openness reading is a statement about WHO the engine cited, not about whether those citations were about this query in this vertical. Queries with no equine or location anchor return whatever is nearest - Australian racing registries, UK cycling bodies, contractor insurance SaaS - and treating that as open ground is a false blue-ocean signal. The gate is additive: it rewrites no occupancy verdict.
